lines: Rahul Bahri, Investor Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 1,800 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds up to ₹0.24 crore if all offered shares are sold; the employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Timing: the money is already in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), which makes a call timely now.
Holdings: an estimated ₹0.57 crore retained at offer price, and the gain is up to ₹0.18 crore before offer expenses and taxes.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings were found in one section only (promoter_holding).
